pages.title: Dipole Bending Magnet
pages.text: A superconducting dipole magnet on a neutronium frame that bends a charged particle beam into a circle. Its field is perfectly uniform across the gap. Metal tools drift toward it. Its field lines would draw a perfect rectangle in iron filings.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A synchrotron needs magnets to curve the beam back on itself. I wound a dipole around a superconducting coil block on a neutronium plate and the beam turned exactly as calculated.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antiproton Decelerator, Hyperion Synchrotron, Particle Spectrometer.
